# @opensourceframework/next-csrf - AI Summary

CSRF protection utilities for Next.js applications. This package is maintained in the OpenSource Framework monorepo as a compatibility-first package for teams that want safer request protection with minimal integration changes.

## Maintainer Intent

- Preserve the original package workflow and public API where safely possible.
- Prefer drop-in or low-friction adoption over recommending a different library by default.
- Modernize internals, testing, and framework compatibility without forcing rewrites.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @opensourceframework/next-csrf
# or
pnpm add @opensourceframework/next-csrf
```

## Links

- Documentation: https://github.com/riceharvest/opensourceframework/tree/main/packages/next-csrf#readme
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opensourceframework/next-csrf
